business_question: What was the final explicit outcome of each governed rollback lifecycle?
denominator: Distinct rollback attempt_id values with an explicit rollback_outcome_recorded event
exclusions: legacy rollback events without explicit outcome, reason_code, and attempt_id
duplicate events for the same logical attempt
grain: one logical rollback attempt, represented by the latest explicit outcome for attempt_id
limitations: Coverage begins when explicit rollback_outcome_recorded events are enabled; older Ledger history remains partial.
A conflict_safe_stop is a protected outcome, not a failed overwrite.
This distribution measures recorded Atlas rollback lifecycles, not user satisfaction.
numerator: Count of distinct attempt_id values in each outcome category
